entities.name: PMID:41057654
observations: India's 2016–2020 UIP evaluation across 31 hospitals in nine states estimated three-dose Rotavac effectiveness against severe rotavirus gastroenteritis at 54% (95% CI 45–62%).

entities.name: PMID:39394601
observations: Interrupted time-series analysis found private-sector rotavirus vaccine sales fell after UIP introduction in Rajasthan (37.4%), Uttar Pradesh-East (72.2%), Tamil Nadu (26%, not statistically clear), and Kerala (3%, not statistically clear); sales were a utilization proxy.
Authors note about 14% of Indian households seek immunization in the private sector, illustrating mixed-provider relevance.

entities.name: PMID:32189688
observations: Study uses Indian private-sector vaccine utilization data from 2012–2015 to estimate the private sector's share in overall immunization coverage; it establishes private delivery as a material component of the mixed system.

entities.name: PMID:39615343
observations: Review of India's rotavirus vaccine evidence describes national UIP adoption supported by clinical, disease-burden, health-economic, and implementation evidence, and identifies post-introduction impact, safety, and delivery evaluation as ongoing needs.

entities.name: PMID:39500219
observations: Indonesia modeling study assessed rotavirus vaccine introduction in the National Immunization Program from health-system and societal perspectives, using cost per DALY averted versus no vaccination; modeled results are country- and assumption-dependent.
